name: Job Readiness Training and Paid Internships (Partners in Education)
org: Santa Barbara County Education Office, Partners in Education
what_you_do: Take a weekly job readiness class on resumes, money, networking and interviews, with a career coach. Finish it and you can apply for a paid internship.
who_can_apply: Students ages 15 to 18 who go to a public high school in Santa Barbara County.
pay_detail: Internships pay minimum wage. A stipend is possible for the training (amount not stated; needs a W-9 and a Social Security card or TIN).
duration: Training is about 1 hour a week for 7 or 8 weeks (page says both). Internship is at least 10 hours a week, 80 hours total.
deadline_text: Training sessions run Fall (Sept to Nov), Spring (Feb to Apr) and Summer (May to June). The page says the internship application is closed right now.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now student form on the page or book a call through the Calendly link there. Phone: (805) 964-4711.
notes: Internship needs a current work permit, a photo ID and a Social Security card. You can take the training without those but get no stipend. This year 10 internship spots are for students interested in energy. Office: 3970 La Colina Rd, Suite 9.
